measurement.aggregates: motion metrics use policy-compliant, independently certified plans; failures remain in the requests denominator
measurement.auxiliary_roles: initial, interior, terminal, or sole normalized motion block
measurement.lengths: reference-frame arc length, distance-weighted A/(A+O); sum of absolute S angles across all vehicles
measurement.provenance: Unique certified proposal consistent with delivered motion structure; ambiguous and unavailable sources reported as null
measurement.stop_rule: All active cars below stop_speed inside a normalized same-gear A block, lasting >= max(stable_time, two controller periods); ends excluded
measurement.timing: 5 warmups and 30 formal repeats kept per task, speed and representative family
